text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in the Danish press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
--The current boom in the building industry will continue throughout the rest of the year and into 1998, a construction business forecast says.
--The tax ministry is evaluating an EU legal decision exempting banks from VAT on some of their data-handling activities.
--Major union Dansk Metal is mobilising in support of last month's Amsterdam EU treaty ahead of a Danish referendum on the accord.
--Deutsche Morgan Grenfell is to seek remote membership of the Copenhagen and Helsinki stock exchanges. It has been on the Stockholm bourse for two years and seeks to broaden its Nordic activities.
--BG Bank is Denmark's most profitable, an analysis by Union Bank of Switzerland shows.
--One in three members of the LO trades union federation who is approaching retirement age would rather cut down their hours of work than stop altogether.
--Bankruptcies are on the rise again for the first time since 1993.
